name: pi-agent-core loop (Xeon own agent loop)
source: packages/agent/src/{agent-loop.ts,types.ts}, read from dist/*.js.map sourcesContent (byte-identical to 1.1.0 sources)
copiedPaths: agent-loop.ts executeToolCalls, executeToolCallsSequential, executeToolCallsParallel, failToolCallsFromTruncatedMessage, shouldTerminateToolBatch (478-692) -> src/loop/tool-batch.ts

types.ts AgentMessage, AgentEvent, AgentTool, AgentToolResult, AgentToolCall, AgentToolUpdateCallback, ToolExecutionMode, AgentContext (names and fields only, no any) -> packages/contracts/src/conversation/agent.ts
notCopied: declareToolChanges (L1.context declares tools in the fixed prefix)
beforeToolCall, afterToolCall, finishTurn, prepareRequest, prepareNextTurn, getSteeringMessages, getFollowUpMessages (callback hooks)
modifications: entry-points: runLoop's two entry points (new prompt, continue) become the four resume entries fresh, request, tools, turn_end (run-turn.ts)
no-outer-loop: the follow-up outer loop is removed; a follow-up starts a new turn (run-turn.ts)
step-functions: commit points and extension points are called by explicit step functions, not by callback hooks (run-turn.ts, open-step.ts, commit-response.ts, step-end.ts)
no-context-array: the loop keeps no message array; every request is rebuilt from committed events by xeon.context (stream-response.ts, prepare-request.ts)
no-api-key: getApiKey/apiKey resolution is removed; core-models leases the key (stream-response.ts)
model-slot: the streamFn is wrapped by the modelCalls limiter slot (stream-response.ts)
batch-cancel: on cancel the remaining calls are settled as not_executed inside the same batch instead of break (tool-batch.ts)
batch-length: a response cut by the output limit settles every call as truncated through tools.settleRejected (tool-batch.ts)
batch-record: per-call prepare/execute/result recording is done by xeon.tools; the loop turns the returned ToolCallOutcome into events (tool-batch.ts)
tracking: Not tracked. New pi-agent-core releases are not followed (adr.0009 section 3.7). Record any hand-ported fix here with the upstream version and function.
